description: Where the gate learns which script tests cover which paths (GX-08, D-070): the per-test covers manifests and the selector files that run the whole script suite.

gate-tests.covers_dir.description: Directory of the per-test covers manifests, one <test>.json per scripts/tests/*.test.sh with script and covers (a leftover modules field has no effect, VAZÃO F57). A new test writes its own (scripts/scaffold does); no PR edits an aggregate map (D-065 V4).

gate-tests.fallback.description: Selector files: a change to one runs every script test, because the choice of tests itself changed. A covers manifest is not one: it selects its own test, the map check (gate-tests.map_check) and every test whose covers glob matches the manifest path.

gate-tests.map_check.description: The script test that validates the whole covers map (one valid manifest per script test). A covers manifest change selects it with the manifest's own test.

gate-tests.traced_file.description: The traced map (PADRAO-DEV F5b-2, D-317), generated by scripts/padrao-metrics traced from a trace of the script tests: per test that is not a scanner, the code files it opened that its covers did not select it for. The gate's selection and the test cache key join it to the declared covers; no hand edits it.
